## Historical audit — S0070

**Scope.** Only chunk 5 of 5 is visible. All citations below refer to S0070, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/ours_without_probes/C1/selection/commons_133800864/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Aspect | Visible evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The final-review instruction asks the student to compare a reference with available renders and select a build or retain the last successful one. A reference-matching scene goal is inferred; the original task and scene content are not visible (line 22, characters [419000,423931)). |
| Operations and validation | Blender’s log reports frame 1 reaching sample 16/16, finishing, saving step 003’s `final.png`, and saving `scene.blend`; the observation reports `observed_render_available: true` (line 22, [419000,423931)). This validates a reported render and save, not visual or geometric correctness. The actual scene edits are not visible. |
| Final decision | A completed, read-only student session was supplied paths for the reference and renders 001–003; it recorded zero tool calls (line 23, [0,4408)). The student answered `DONE` (line 24, [0,362)); a subsequent `select` event records step 3 (line 25, [0,59)). The instruction defined `DONE` as keeping the last successful rendered build. |
| Teacher and exploration | No teacher input, diagnosis, proposed update, execution of such an update, or evidence of student adoption appears in this chunk. The final session itself shows no tool-based autonomous exploration; earlier exploration remains unknown. |
| Scene-specific checks | The log’s plural object and mesh update labels do not independently establish multiple meaningful scene objects. Materials or textures, part connections, pose, and camera/light quality cannot be assessed without the images or scene data. Light and camera-volume update log entries alone do not establish an issue or its absence (line 22, [419000,423931)). |

**Outcome and uncertainty.** Step 3 was formally selected after a reported successful render; task correctness is **unknown**, not established success or failure. There is no visible empty patch, algorithm failure, or technical interruption. The final review’s execution limit is a workflow constraint, not evidence of interruption. The images were supplied to the student but are not visible in this audit, so neither the selection nor a filename verifies resemblance.

**Lessons.** Transferably, distinguish a completed render and selection from independent visual validation, and distinguish an input being available from advice being received and adopted. Any task-specific diagnosis or hypothesis about scene quality remains unresolved because the reference, renders, earlier operations, and other chunks are unseen.
